name: Ranger Foehunter
body:
There has frequently been enmity between groups whose territories abut each other and for whom resources and space are fought over. The borders of these territories are protected by foehunters that excel at hunting their rivals.

Uncanny Dodge (Ex)

At 2nd level, the foehunter gains uncanny dodge as the barbarian class feature.

This ability replaces the combat style feat gained at 2nd level.

Sneak Attack (Ex)

At 4th level, the foehunter gains a 1d6 sneak attack as the rogue ability of the same name.

This ability increases by 1d6 for every 3 levels thereafter.

This ability replaces hunter’s bond.

Improved Uncanny Dodge (Ex)

At 8th level, the foehunter gains improved uncanny dodge as the barbarian class feature, using their ranger level as their barbarian level.

This ability replaces the favored terrain gained at 8th level.

Dodge Critical (Ex)

At 10th level, the foehunter is adept at dodging the powerful attacks of their sworn foes. If subject to a confirmed critical hit by a favored enemy, the foehunter may roll a Reflex save (DC equal to the 20 + the enhancement bonus of the attacking weapon, if any). If successful the attack is converted to a normal hit. The foehunter must be aware of the attack and not flat-footed. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to the foehunter’s Wisdom modifier.

This ability replaces the combat style feat gained at 10th level.
